notes: Very clean course: ~83% false positives. Most flags are atomic English function words/articles/prepositions and verb forms glossed as 'component' slices inside larger LEGOs (fp_subgloss, 65) or pure English morphology of one lemma — speak/speaking, to help/help, said/say, pay/to pay (fp_inflection, 32); none of the high-frequency drilled tokens are overloaded. The real issues are all multi-word drilled phrases: a recurring möchte (want vs I'd like) and anderes (else vs different) rendering split, several drops of nicht/es/darüber/stecken (4 fp_wrong_data), to/bare infinitive inconsistencies, and one genuine wenn = when/if overload. No high-severity learner-constant collisions, so 0 release blockers.
